tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Return the current top-of-book mid, bid, and ask for the traded symbol, plus the current episode step.

tools.name: get_orderbook
tools.description: Return the current order book depth (bids/asks with size) around the mid.

tools.name: get_position
tools.description: Return your current net inventory (signed units), the stated max inventory limit, and your live working quotes.

tools.name: get_pnl
tools.description: Return your running realized + unrealized PnL proxy and a risk-adjusted figure (PnL penalized for inventory risk).

tools.name: regime_signals
tools.description: Return observable microstructure diagnostics for the most recent window: short-horizon return autocorrelation, realized volatility, and order-flow imbalance. These describe behavior; they do NOT name a regime.

tools.name: get_fills
tools.description: Return the fills you have received so far (each fill changes your net inventory).

tools.name: volatility
tools.description: Return the realized volatility series so far (one value per elapsed step).

tools.name: set_strategy
tools.description: Set your active market-making strategy. Accepts a `mode` string. Recorded with the step at which you set it.

tools.name: post_quote
tools.description: Post a two-sided quote (bid/ask price + size). Advances the market one step; you may receive fills that move your inventory according to the live regime.

tools.name: cancel_quote
tools.description: Cancel your live working quotes (stand aside). Advances the market one step with no new fills for you.

tools.name: hedge
tools.description: Trade `qty` units (signed: negative to sell down a long, positive to cover a short) at the current mid to reduce net inventory. Does not advance the market.

tools.name: settle
tools.description: Close the trading session and book the result. Returns the graded outcome.
